about: The data-day job registry (ripples/docs/dataday_v1.md). Each job is a registered test, or the registered remainder of one, that stopped on a refusal and runs again on a later day: its plan, the frozen code it runs (commit, path and sha256, run unchanged), its arguments, the hosts it may contact, its request budget, how to tell it finished, and the done marker that keeps it from ever running twice. A gate holds a job until a person clears it. To change a job, edit its entry and raise its revision; a hold from an earlier attempt applies only to the revision it was recorded under.

robots_exceptions.reason: Wikipedia's robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows /w/ and asks crawlers to stay off dynamically generated pages. The Action API at /w/api.php is the interface Wikimedia publishes for programs, under its API etiquette and User-Agent policy (one request at a time, an identifying agent), and every Wikipedia measurement in this project has used it. This entry is an owner decision: delete it and every job that reads the Wikipedia API is held by robots.txt instead.
The same Wikimedia robots.txt and the same API policy as en.wikipedia.org. Owner decision, as above.

jobs.notes: The code is the registration commit's scorer, so the run is the plan as written, not the Oct 5 deviation (u4 dropped). Its own cache (--cache) lives in the job's cache folder and persists in the Actions cache, so a run that stops again resumes from what it already fetched; the plan says raw responses are not committed, so commit_cache is false. en.wikipedia.org is paced at one request every 2 s, slower than the 1 s rate the 429 came at. The result is surprise_v1_registered.json; reconciling it with docs/surprise_v1.md is the test owner's step.

jobs.notes: The code is the commit that carries the disclosed matcher fix (fold) and the rescan command (docs/records2_v1.md, deviation 1). The rescan makes seven requests and saves nothing until it ends, so the polite cache keeps each text it gets: after a stop, the next attempt asks only for the texts it lacks. The output is the Lac-Megantic block of the raw file; the hand read and the build step the plan requires stay with the test owner. The four paragraphs of deviation 4 are not registered here.
